result.keyword: Who are the best luxury real estate agencies in Australia? Give me a shortlist of specific prestige property agencies with reasons.

items.markdown:
Australia’s top luxury real estate agencies combine high-profile networks, discreet white-glove client servicing , and deep access to high-net-worth domestic and international buyers.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)[[2]](https://agent.domain.com.au/advice/inside-the-playbook-of-australias-top-prestige-agents-1408401/)

The premier prestige property agencies across the country include:

- Sydney Sotheby’s International Realty[Sydney Sotheby’s International Realty](https://sydneysothebysrealty.com/) (Sydney, Byron Bay, and national reach) – Renowned for handling ultra-prime coastal and harbor-front estates (such as in Point Piper and Vaucluse). They leverage an unmatched global referral network and go to extreme lengths—such as international VIP client travel—to secure and market elite properties.[[1]](https://www.sothebysrealty.com/eng/sales/aus)[[2]](https://agent.domain.com.au/advice/inside-the-playbook-of-australias-top-prestige-agents-1408401/)
- The Rubinstein Group (TRG)[The Rubinstein Group (TRG)](https://www.rohatyngroup.com/) (Sydney's Eastern Suburbs) – Founded by Gavin Rubinstein, TRG dominates high-end residential sales through heavy digital media presence, non-traditional private viewings, and curated soft-launch events rather than conventional open homes.[[1]](https://www.therubinsteingroup.com/)[[2]](https://agent.domain.com.au/advice/inside-the-playbook-of-australias-top-prestige-agents-1408401/)
- **Marshall White** (Melbourne) – The leading prestige agency for luxury period homes, contemporary architectural builds, and high-end apartments across Melbourne’s elite inner-suburbs like Toorak, Brighton, and Armadale.[[1]](https://www.marshallwhite.com.au/)
- **Amir Prestige** (Gold Coast & Northern NSW) – A dominant force in Queensland’s luxury coastal market, famous for record-shattering beachfront sales along Hedges Avenue and deep connections with prominent high-net-worth buyers and celebrities.[[1]](https://www.amirprestige.com.au/)

If you have a **specific city or region** in mind, or if you are looking to **buy or sell** , I can narrow down the exact agent and recent comparable sales for you.
